answer: Charge each new identity a rising admission cost paid in graded work, not idle wallets. A farm can spin up a comet of throwaway accounts, but every one must first pass a shale-hard proof of useful output before it can vote or earn. That cost compounds with each failed panel check, so the attacker’s budget burns before the network’s pulse of rewards. Kin-linked clones earn nothing; only independent, lasting work unlocks standing.
